personalDetails.headline: Senior Frontend Engineer · React, TypeScript, Next.js

entries.text: Senior Frontend Engineer with 6 years on e-commerce and SaaS web apps for more than 2 million users a month. Strong in web performance, design systems, accessibility, and Playwright testing. Lead a team of 4 and maintain an open-source address library used by 40 Vietnamese shops.

entries.description: Vietnamese address library in TypeScript that parses and normalizes addresses after the 2025 province merger: 300 GitHub stars, 3,000 npm downloads a week.
entries.title: vn-address-kit

entries.description: Open checklist and demo repository for Core Web Vitals in Next.js; used by 3 local teams, 1,200 GitHub stars.
entries.title: Next.js performance checklist

entries.description:
• Lead a team of 4 moving the shopping app from a React SPA to Next.js; LCP fell from 4.1 s to 1.9 s.
  • Maintain a 60-component React and TypeScript design system for 5 product teams, which cut feature build time by about 30%.
  • Run A/B tests on the checkout flow; 6 tests raised conversion by 9%.
  • Cut the home page JavaScript bundle from 480 KB to 210 KB with code splitting.
  • Keep the checkout at WCAG 2.1 AA with axe checks in CI, after fixing 140 accessibility issues in 3 months.

• Built the inventory dashboard in React and GraphQL for 800 retail businesses.
  • Set up Playwright end-to-end tests in GitLab CI, cutting regressions that reached production by 70%.
  • Added virtual scrolling to a 10,000-row table, bringing scroll lag down from 3 s to 0.3 s.
  • Built an offline-first point-of-sale screen with IndexedDB, so 300 stores kept selling through network outages.

• Booking system for a Japanese clinic chain (8 months): built 12 admin screens in React.
  • Recruitment website for a Singapore client (6 months): built the responsive UI in Vue.js, scoring 95 in mobile Lighthouse.
  • Wrote Jest unit tests for the booking flow, raising coverage from 30% to 80%.
